tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rten 'brel lnga rdzogs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o// zhes bya ba'i don ni/ spyir rten 'brel lnga'i dgongs pa so sor bshad na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang bsdu na gsum ste/ rgyu'i rten 'brel dang*/ lam gyi rten 'brel dang*/ 'bras bu'i rten 'brel lo// de la rgyu'i rten 'brel lnga ni/ phyi'i rten 'brel phyi rol gyi yul las 'byung*/ nang gi rten 'brel lus rtsa la/ gsang ba rten 'brel rtsa yi ge la/ de kho na nyid rten 'brel khams bdud rtsi la/ mthar thug rten 'brel rlung la brtsi'o// gnyis pa sems la rten 'brel lngar brtsi na/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes phyi'i rten 'brel/ yid kyi rnam shes nang rten 'brel/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gsang ba rten 'brel/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa/ de kho na nyid rten 'brel/ chos kyi dbyings mthar thug rten 'brel lo// lam la gnyis las/ smin par byed pa dbang la brtsi na/ sta gon gyi gnas skabs kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa phyi'i rten 'brel/ bum dbang nang rten 'brel/ gsang dbang gsang ba rten 'brel/ shes rab ye shes de kho na nyid rten 'brel/ dbang bzhi pa mthar thug rten 'brel lo// lam gyi gnyis pa bskyed rim la sbyar na/ phyi rol de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba phyi rten 'brel/ lus la sangs rgyas su go ba nang rten 'brel/ ngag tu brjod tshad sngags su shes pa gsang ba rten 'brel/ sems ye shes su shes pa de kho na nyid rten 'brel/ de thams cad dbyer med pa'i ye shes su shar ba mthar thug rten 'brel lo// rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gsum las/ rang byin brlab la sbyar na/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor phyi/ rtsi'i 'khor lo nang rten 'brel/ rtsa yi ge gsang ba/ khams bdud rtsi de kho na nyid/ snying po ye shes rlung sgom pa mthar thug rten 'brel lo// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sbyar na/

las kyi phyag rgya phyi rten 'brel/ bdag gi lus kyi 'khrul 'khor nang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab pa gsang pa/ yas 'bab kyi dga' ba de kho na nyid/ snying po ye shes rlung mas brtan gyi dga' ba mthar thug rten 'brel lo// rdo rje rba rlabs la sbyar na/ lam thams cad mngon du song ba phyi/ lus kyi rba rlabs nang*/ ngag gi rba rlabs gsang ba/ sems kyi rba rlabs de kho na nyid/ de dag gi ye shes mthar thug rten 'brel lo// pha rol tu phyin pa dang sgo bstun na/ lam lnga la rten 'brel lngar sbyar ba ni shes par sla'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi nye rgyu la sbyar na/ rlung log la sogs pa phyi/ nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga ste rlung lnga nang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lnga ste khams bdud rtsi gsang ba/ de'i rten 'brel gyis dngos grub rnams rang las 'byung ba shes pa ni/ de kho na nyid/ de'i stobs kyis re dogs dang bral ba ni mthar thug go /de nyid rdo rje tshig rkang las/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyi rten 'brel/ rlung log la sogs gsum gsum ni zhes bya ba'i rim pa la sogs pa'i rim pa ltar sbyar ro// 'bras bu la gnyis las/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu la sbyar na/ lam tshogs sbyor gnyis phyi rten 'brel/ bum pa'i dbang sa drug nang*/ gsang dbang sa bzhi gsang ba/ shes rab ye shes sa gnyis de kho na nyid/ dbang bzhi pa sa phyed mthar thug rten 'brel lo// sa so so la rten 'brel sbyar na/ 'jig rten pa'i sa la tshogs lam phyi/ sbyor lam drod nang*/ rtse mo gsang ba/ bzod pa de kho na nyid/ 'jig rten chos mchog mthar thug rten 'brel lo// tshogs lam la'ang phyi dbyibs kyi tshogs lam la sogs pa shes par sla'o// 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa so so la sbyar te sa dang po la mtshon na/ rgyal ba sprul sku las dbang bzhi len pa phyi/ rtsa'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba nang*/ yi ge'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba gsang ba/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba de kho na nyid/

snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor mthong ba ni mthar thug rten 'brel lo// bum dbang gi phyi rten 'brel sprul sku las dbang bzhi len/ gsang dbang gi longs sku/ shes rab ye shes kyi chos sku/ dbang bzhi pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku las dbang bzhi len pa'o// bum dbang la gtso bor rtsa'i ldog pa mthong*/ gsang dbang la yi ge'i ldog pa mthong*/ shes rab ye shes la khams bdud rtsi/ dbang bzhi pa la snying po ye shes rlung gi ldog pa mthong*/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du phyi rten 'brel gtsor 'grig bum dbang sa drug pa la nang rten 'brel gtsor 'grig gsang dbang sa bzhi pa la gsang ba rten 'brel 'grig shes rab ye shes sa gnyis la de kho na nyid rten 'brel 'grig dbang bzhi pa sa phyed la mthar thug rten 'brel 'grig go /mthar thug 'bras bu la rten 'brel lnga bzhag na/ phyi rten 'brel la rgyal ba sprul sku/ nang dang gsang ba rten 'brel gnyis la longs sku/ de kho na nyid la chos sku/ mthar thug rten 'brel la ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub bo// yang na rten 'brel lnga po sku lnga la sbyar na yang 'grub bo// de dag kyang rdo rje tshig rkang las/ phyi nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lam gyis zhes bya ba las/ mthar thug rten 'brel gyis mthar thug dag par byed ces bya ba dang*/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin par rten 'brel 'grig pa ltar snang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dgongs pa yin no// rgyu dus kyi rten 'brel lnga cung zad tsam brjod na/ phyi rten 'brel phyi rol rags pa la bsgrigs pas gang 'dod pa 'grub/ de bzhin du nang rten 'brel lus rtsa la bsgrig gsang ba rten 'brel ngag dang ye ge la bsgrig de kho na nyid rten 'brel sems dang khams bdud rtsi la bsgrig mthar thug rten 'brel ye shes dang rlung la bsgrigs pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i don 'grub/ dper na nad gang yang rung ba gso ba la yang*/

phyi rten 'brel sman dpyad dang 'khyug dpyad kyis kyang sos/ nang gi rten 'brel lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang rtsa'i dmigs pas sos/ gsang ba rten 'brel rtsa yi ge dang*/ gtum mo'i me dang*/ ngag 'dren pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi rten 'brel khams bdud rtsi dang*/ sems kyi dmigs pa sna tshogs dang*/ mthar thug rten 'brel la rlung gi dmigs pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnad 'ga' zhig gis kyang sos pa yod do// dper na nad mdze lta bu la dngul chu'i bcud len dang*/ a riṣ+ṭa'i sman sbyor la sogs pa phyi rten 'brel/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas pa dang*/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus la sogs kyi sgo nas nad las grol nas 'gro ba yod pa ni nang rten 'brel lo// rtsa yi ge sna tshogs kyi gnad dang*/ gtum mo me'i dmigs pa sna tshogs dang*/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag dang hūm̐ rings huṃ thung dang hag dang hig dang phaṭa la sogs pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag gis kyang nad thams cad las grol ba yod de/ de gsang ba rten 'brel yin/ khams bdud rtsi sna tshogs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ yul lnga la sems 'dzin pa'i thabs dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma la sems 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas kyang nad gdon las grol ba 'ang yod de/ de kho na nyid rten 'brel yin/ rlung gi sbyor ba bdun dang*/ yan lag gi rlung phra mo'i dmigs pa sna tshogs dang*/ bu ga mang po'i sbyor ba dang*/ steng 'og gi 'khor lo med pa dang*/ rlung rngan dag byin pa la sogs pa'i gnad sna tshogs dang sems snang ba dang*/ stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i gnad dang*/ bde ba dang stong pa'i ting 'dzin skyed pa'i thabs dang*/ mi rtog pa'i rten 'brel skyed pa'i thabs dang*/

rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi kyang nad dang gdon thams cad las grol ba yod de/ de mthar thug rten 'brel yin no// pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du// dri ldan me tog bung ba sdud// sha yi dri la sha sbrang 'du// 'brog bzang du ni ri dwags 'du// bza' btung mang sar skye bo 'tshogs// gal te de dag mi ldan na// bsdus kyang skye bo phal cher 'bros// dro zhing brlan sar nags tshal skye// de sogs phyi yi rten 'brel yin// mchod la brtson na mchod par 'gyur// byams pa byas na glags kyis byams// bdag gis bla ma mchod byas na// sems can kun gyis bdag mchod 'gyur// dam pa'i chos la gus byas na// sangs rgyas kun gyi chos mdzod 'dzin// dge 'dun rnams ni mnyes byas na// de 'dun dam pa rnams ni sdud// 'khor rnams bsam pa dag pa yis// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'du bar 'gyur// mdor na bsam pa dag pa yis// gang dang gang la 'dod sems yod// shes na de dang de dag 'du// bsam ngan rnams kyis ma shes na// gang 'dod de las bzlog pa 'byung*/ de sogs nang gi rten 'brel yin// rtsa yig gsal dang mi gsal las// rjod pa gsal dang mi gsal 'byung*// sems kyi 'phen pa drag zhan las// ngag gi nus pa che chung 'byung*// las kyi 'phen pa bzang ngan las// brjod pa'i rten 'brel bzang ngan srid// drang srong dka' thub grub pa dang*// 'phags pa'i bden pa grub pa dang*// nang gi rten 'brel grub pa yis// ji ltar smon pa brjod tsam gyis// de dang de ni 'grub par 'gyur// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pas// gsang ba dbang gi rab byed du// ā li kā li mdor gsungs pa// rgyas par gzhan du gsungs zhes grags// de bzhin gtsug gi nor bu sogs// yi ge ring thung bsdebs pa las// 'jig rten kun gyi bde legs 'byung*// de sogs gsang ba'i rten 'brel yin// chos kun gdod nas skye ba med// skye ba nyid kyang ma skyes pa// skye med nyid kyi skye ba ston// des na skyes dang ma skyes pa// snang ba dang ni stong pa dang*// rtog pa dang ni rtog med dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yang*// dam pa'i don du dbye ba med// dbye ba med la dbye ba 'byung*// dbye ba med pa'i dbye shes na// 'khor 'das kun gyi de nyid rtogs// shes bya kun gyi de nyid go

/bzang ngan kun gyi de nyid shes// rtogs rgyu med pa'i don rtogs pas// grol rgyu med pa'i sems nyid grol// shes bya med pa'i shes bya shes// bshad rgyu med pa'i bshad la mkhas// 'dod pa med par 'dod don 'grub// shes bya kun la bzo byed pas// chos rnams kun gyi rgyal por 'gyur// de sogs de nyid rten 'brel yin// dngos po'i mtha' ni gzugs kyi sku// dngos med mtha' ni chos kyi sku// 'khor ba'i mtha' ni srid pa'i rtsa// mya ngan 'das mtha' lhag med dbyings// zung 'jug mtha' ni rdo rje 'chang*// spang bya'i mtha' ni gnas ngan len// gnyen po'i mtha' ni nye ba'i rgyu// ye shes mtha' ni chos kyi dbyings// thabs lam kun gyi mthar thug pa// rdo rje theg pa yin zhes bya// de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa// mthar thug pa yi rten 'brel yin// chos kun rten cing 'brel 'byung zhes// rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces mdzod yin// nyan thos rang rgyal sems tsam dang*// dbu ma pa yang rten 'brel bzhed// 'on kyang rten 'brel bcu gnyis la// bshad pa'i dbye ba tha dad yod// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni// rten 'brel lam du byed par gsungs// rgyud rnams kun gyi dgongs pa yang*// rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar snang*// 'on kyang rten 'brel lam byed pa'i// zab mo'i gnad ni 'di yin zhes// gsang sngags lam 'bras ma yin pa// gzhan du gsal bar gsungs pa med// des na lam 'bras mi shes na// rten 'brel zab mo shes mi nus// dang po'i sgom chen thams cad la'ang*// rten 'brel zhes bya'i kha skad med// phyi nas lam 'bras 'phel ba'i rgyus// rten 'brel zhes bya'i kha skad byung*// 'on kyang phyi nang rten 'brel gnad// da dung gzhan gyis shes pa med// glegs bam tsam la brten pa yi// lam 'bras pa yis 'di ma shes// bla ma'i gsung la gus pa yi// nyan pa goms pa'i sbyor ba dang*// snyan brgyud gzhan du ma bcos pa'i// khrid rnams legs par tshar ba dang*// bla ma legs par mnyes pa las// byung ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*// dbang gi chu bo ma nub par// legs par thob cing lam dus kyi// dbang bzhi thun bzhir bsgoms pa las// drod gsher 'dzom pa'i sa phyogs su// rtsi shing me tog skye ba ltar// snyan brgyud bzhi po 'grig pa las// rten 'brel zab mo nang nas 'char// lam 'bras rdo rje tshig rkang las// rten 'brel lnga yis lam rdzogs zhes// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa mdo tsam zhig

/bla ma'i dgongs pa bdag gis bris// shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang por grags pa de la ring mo nas// yang yang gsol ba 'debs pa'i blo gros can// sdom brtson mang thos bla ma la gus pa// de yis gsol ba btab nas 'di bshad do// lam 'bras rdo rje tshig rkang las/ rten 'brel lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o// zhes bya ba'i dgongs pa phyogs tsam zhig mdo smad rtse sgab kyi sdom brtson seṅge rgyal mtshan legs kyis gus pas yang yang gsol ba btab nas/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos sbyar ba'o// sems can la phan pa rgya chen po byed par gyur cig /sa māp+ta mi thi/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
